sequential_reading.notes: All 11 PDF pages were read sequentially in page order. The first page had also been inspected beforehand only to verify identity; that preliminary look was not counted. The proof of the pair theorem explicitly assumes both states invertible; a separate root-local regularization/support lemma is required for the general singular case.

topics_and_locators.locator: PDF pp.2-3; Eq. (1)-(3); two-state family, each output marginal must equal the input; broadcastable iff the pair commute is stated at p.3; commuting-state construction by copying a simultaneous eigenbasis is Eq. (3).

PDF pp.3-10; fidelity definition and POVM minimum-overlap formula Eq. (4)-(5), polar-decomposition/Cauchy-Schwarz derivation Eq. (6)-(11), partial-trace monotonicity Eq. (12)-(13), unitary/ancilla invariance Eq. (14)-(16), equality forced by broadcasting Eq. (17), invertible-state equality analysis Eq. (19)-(31).
PDF p.7, Eq. (18): broadcast-as-product cloning implies F=F^2, so states identical or orthogonal; converse by discrimination or identical inputs.
PDF pp.8-10 explicitly assumes rho0 and rho1 invertible to simplify the commutativity proof; singular cases are not discharged in this paper's displayed proof.
